_note: Address book, not a schema store. Keyed by provider@ref. Per entry: defaults (in the model's NATIVE field names, shallow-merged under your input, your input wins), estCostUsd (rough, for dry-run totals), timeoutSec (override of the 15 min default), notes (free text for whoever writes the input; gen inspect gives the live schema). Any endpoint works without an entry here.

replicate@google/nano-banana-2.notes: Usual image default. Reference images go in image_input (array of URLs).

replicate@black-forest-labs/flux-2-max.notes: Reference images go in input_images (array of URLs).

replicate@black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein.notes: Cheapest image model here; good for smoke tests.

replicate@ideogram-ai/ideogram-v3-turbo.notes: Strong at rendering text inside images (posters, signs, UI copy). No output_format field. Only prompt is required. resolution (WxH enum) overrides aspect_ratio when set. magic_prompt_option defaults to Auto and may rewrite prompts; set it to Off when exact on-image wording matters. Style refs go in style_reference_images (array of URLs); style_preset offers named looks. Inpainting via image + mask (black pixels repainted).

replicate@bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast.notes: i2v only: needs a start image; fails on pure text-to-video.

replicate@kwaivgi/kling-v3-video.notes: Start image field is start_image. Supports t2v (omit start_image).

replicate@openai/sora-2-pro.notes: Quirks: i2v image field is input_reference; duration field is seconds and only 4, 8 or 12; aspect_ratio is portrait|landscape, not 9:16.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/tts/eleven-v3.notes: TTS via fal. Fields: text, voice (name, e.g. Rachel), stability, similarity_boost, style, speed, apply_text_normalization. For request stitching or word timestamps use the direct elevenlabs provider instead.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/music.notes: Music generation. Fields: prompt, music_length_ms, force_instrumental.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/speech-to-text/scr.notes: STT with word-level timestamps. Fields: audio_url, language_code (e.g. eng), keyterms (max 100 items, 50 chars each).
